_note: Episode 11 (S2E3) keyframes, same method as Episode 9. Butuan river port, 1011. Real people (traders, crews, the envoy at the Song court) are generic figures, far or from behind, never likenesses; Rajah Kiling appears only as light (no face, no body). The court in China is shown only through the lens (the diwa's telling). The 1976 gold seekers are generic. The Golden Tara is a generic seated gold figurine in a case, not a copy of the real object. No weapons. Copied from Episode 10: full intro, indio_read_marker, notebook_glow, portal_gate, usman_return, ships_north; chars indio_point_modern, usman_growl; plate school_gate. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
